name: SimpleBollinger upper-band breakout in Ichimoku uptrend
author: gabrielweich (jesse-strategies)
license: MIT (repo LICENSE; individual authors per README)
indicators: Bollinger Bands on hl2 (jesse defaults 20,2); Ichimoku default cloud
entry_long: close > BB upperband AND close > cloud span_a AND span_b
exit: close < BB middleband (docstring says best result; code uses bb[1]=middle)
implementation_notes: bb tuple order in jesse is (upper,middle,lower). Jesse note: README states these are code examples, not profitable strategies.
